summary: Iteration 2 backend testing complete. Added 4 new tests for AES/Fernet audio encryption + /api/cases/{id}/audio endpoint, re-ran full suite. 24/24 tests passed (20 original + 4 new). Verified: audio_b64 is encrypted at rest as Fernet token (gAAAAA... prefix), never plaintext in DB; counsellor/supervisor can decrypt via GET /audio and get original base64 back; victim gets 403; null returned when no audio; audit_log entry with action='audio_play' is created on each decrypt. No regressions in seed/auth/SVI/cases/draft/queue/escalate/audit-log/support-directory.
critical_code_review_comments: crypto_util.py comment claims AES-256 but Fernet is AES-128-CBC+HMAC-SHA256; acceptable per agent-to-agent note, but update docstring/README for honesty.
_pseudo_encrypt() helper name in server.py is misleading now that real Fernet encryption is used — rename to _encrypt_audio_field().

GET /cases/{id}/audio has no victim ownership check path — correctly 403s all victims; but counsellor can fetch audio for any case including those not assigned to them. Consider restricting to assigned_counsellor_id or supervisor.
Fernet() instance is created at import time; if AUDIO_ENC_KEY is rotated the process must be restarted — acceptable but document.
